messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: weve published a global leave & travel policy refresh that goes into effect May 1. Main changes in the thread below + FAQ link.
omar: Quick summary please?
Maya (People Ops): TL;DR: standardized accrual schedules across EMEA/APAC (some local overrides), new 3-day "mental health" discretionary days (no notes required), pilot sabbatical program for employees 5+ years (app process opens Jun 1), and clarified when PTO is encashed on termination for each jurisdiction. Travel: updated emergency assistance vendor and updated per-diem bands for high-cost cities.
gina: Will this change holiday calendars or just accrual?
Maya (People Ops): Only accrual and carry rules changed. Public holiday calendars remain per-country.
trevor (Legal): Note 0: some countries require different notice periods for leave payout; Legal will append country exceptions. Don't rely on the global table for statutory obligations.
sophia (Benefits): Parental leave top-up clarified: core markets get 8 weeks at full pay top-up (after statutory leave) and a resource kit. Were running a separate pilot for two smaller markets where we cant offer top-up yet. Eligibility details in the FAQ.
payroll-bot: Payroll impact note posted  https://intranet.redwood.com/payroll/leave-accruals (automated)
omar: For the sabbatical pilot, how does headcount approval work?
Ellen (People Ops): Managers nominate; People Ops + Finance review capacity impact. Sabbatical is unpaid by default but can use PTO/leave bank. Program details on the sign-up page.
gina: Are contractors covered for the 3 mental health days?
Maya (People Ops): No, discretionary days are for regular employees. Contractors follow their contract terms.
trevor (Legal): Also added an explicit non-retaliation clause to the Code of Conduct section in the policy page. If you see retaliation after reporting, escalate to Legal + People Ops.
Maya (People Ops): Action items: 1) Review the policy page and FAQ. 2) Managers: confirm any carryover requests for team members by Apr 15. 3) If youre eligible for sabbatical, read the pilot criteria. 4) Book travel through the approved vendor to get emergency assistance coverage.
omar: Will there be a company-wide email?
Maya (People Ops): Yes  well send an email to all, post on the intranet, and show a banner in the next all-hands. Drop-in Q&A tomorrow 4pm UTC: https://meet.redwood.com/people-ops/policy-refresh (will record).
all-hands-bot: Announcement posted to #all-hands (automated)
Maya (People Ops): FAQs will be updated this afternoon. If you're a local People Ops partner and need editable slides for your local town hall, DM me.
gina: Thanks! Sharing with EMEA HR leads.
Ellen (People Ops): Filing note: well run a 90-day review of the take-up of mental health days and the sabbatical pilot metrics.
Maya (People Ops): Final TL;DR: effective May 1  global accrual alignment, 3 discretionary mental health days, sabbatical pilot for long-tenured employees, clarified parental top-up & termination encashment rules, travel emergency vendor update, and Code of Conduct non-retaliation reminder. Questions -> #people-ops or hr@redwood.com :loudspeaker: 
reactions summary: :thumbsup: x9, :eyes: x3
